plan.title: Atelier promo — integrations beat
plan.summary: Adds a two-second integrations card after the personal scene, restyles the fallback line with a glow, adds a tap on the habit tracker and a CTA cue, and keeps the original soundtrack.

scenes.label: Logo and promise
scenes.on_screen_text: Atelier. A personal AI studio. Shaped around you.

scenes.label: The usual setup
scenes.on_screen_text: Five apps. Five tabs. None of them know you.

scenes.label: Six ways to make
scenes.on_screen_text: Ask. Code. Image. Video. Ideas. Build.

scenes.label: The best models
scenes.on_screen_text: Auto picks the right model for the job, and falls back if one goes down.

scenes.label: Come make something yours
scenes.on_screen_text: Come make something yours. Sign in with LinkedIn. atelier.ciprari.ai

style.look: Near-black studio palette, warm ivory serif headlines, electric-lime accents, calm editorial pacing.

timeline.why: Keep the opening through the personal scene.
The integrations beat the note asked for.
Shorten the close 8 → 6 s to keep 48 s.

lines.text: Auto picks the right model for the job,
and falls back if one goes down.

notes: The integrations card uses a blurred frame from 0:24 as its backdrop.
